request_description: A web application architecture featuring Nodecellar (a Node.js web application) running on a Node.js web server hosted on a virtual machine (vm_app). The application connects to a PostgreSQL database (PostgreSQL_BDD) hosted on a PostgreSQL DBMS, which is deployed on a separate virtual machine (vm_db). Both virtual machines are connected to a network (app_network) and run Ubuntu 22.04 LTS. The web application is exposed on port 3000 and interacts with the database over TCP.
